batchGoal: Replace the 36 remaining mixed-style source card images with unified AI presentation images while retaining every original source image as the detail and historical reference.
sharedPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: vertical 4:5 museum artifact card image. Image 1 is the authoritative subject reference. Preserve the photographed artifact's silhouette, proportions, material, patina, decoration layout, damage, number of components and viewing identity as closely as visible. Change only the surrounding presentation: remove gallery clutter, visitors, labels, glass glare, support furniture and distracting walls; place the artifact in a near-black warm museum setting with restrained amber top light, a subtle floor or conservation-support shadow and generous negative space. Keep the complete subject inside a safe central area and keep the lower-right corner visually quiet for a UI seal. Photorealistic catalog presentation, not fantasy reconstruction. No people, hands, readable text, logos, watermark, invented inscriptions, added components or historical scenery. Historical fidelity is more important than spectacle.
